findings.label: Social-login creds read but intentionally unused
findings.detail: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / FACEBOOK_APP_ID / INSTAGRAM_APP_ID are read and passed to socialLogin(), which voids them and shows a 'setup pending' toast. Intentional and documented in a TODO because the /users/social-login endpoint is not deployed. Listed only so the dead-read is tracked for the follow-up that wires real OAuth.
